question: A network engineer must enable port security on all Cisco MDS Series Switches in the fabric. The requirement is to avoid the extensive manual configuration of the switch ports. Which action must be taken to meet these requirements?
options: Enable the auto-learning port security feature.
Enable the auto-learning port security feature on a per-VSAN basis.
Activate CFS distribution and the auto-learning port security feature.
Activate CFS distribution and the auto-learning port security feature on a per-VSAN basis.
theory: Combining Cisco Fabric Services (CFS) distribution with per-VSAN auto-learning port security minimizes manual work in two ways: auto-learning removes the need to manually enter every device WWN and port pairing (the switch discovers them automatically), and CFS distribution propagates that configuration from one switch to every other switch in the fabric once committed, instead of repeating the setup on each switch individually. Auto-learning itself is always a per-VSAN setting in Cisco MDS NX-OS. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 20 - Port Security, Method 3: Auto-Learning with CFS Distribution)
